question: Convert binary number 1101.1101 into decimal equivalent.
solution:
The correct answer is __13.8125**(Option 2)**.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Binary__ is a base-2 numeral system consisting of only 0s and 1s.
 
• To convert binary 1101.1101 to decimal, separate it into integer and fractional parts:
 
• The integer part is 1101 (binary), which equals 13 (decimal).
 
• The fractional part is .1101 (binary), which equals 0.8125 (decimal).
 
• Adding these together gives the final decimal equivalent: 13.8125.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Binary to Decimal Conversion:**
 
 
• For the integer part, multiply each binary digit by 2 raised to its position (from right, starting at 0).
 
• For the fractional part, multiply each binary digit by 2 raised to its negative position (starting at -1).
 
 
 
• **Examples:**
 
 
• Binary 101.01 is 5.25 (decimal).
 
• Binary 11.11 is 3.75 (decimal).
